## Embeds 

Obsidian has an embed syntax (a `!` before the double brackets, embedding
another note or an image inline) is not specially handled. 

## A wikilink immediately followed by `:`

`[[Target]]:` at the very start of a line, most commonly a list item like
`- [[Target]]: some description`. Pandoc's
own Markdown reader parses `[Target]:` as a
[link reference definition](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/#link-reference-definitions)
before quarto-graph's filter ever runs, consuming the rest of the line as
the link's destination and silently dropping that list item's visible
text. Wrapping the wikilink in bold, `- **[[Target]]**: some description`,
avoids it, since the line no longer starts with a bare `[`.
